title: PluginRegisteredPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'plugin.registered'. Loombre Plugin Protocol (LPP) v1, Lane W2 (LD4/LD6): emitted in the SAME transaction as the plugins row insert (packages/db/src/query/plugins.ts's insertPluginAndEmit) at the end of the registration state machine. ADMIN-ONLY delivery (apps/server/src/gateway/ws-broadcaster.service.ts's ADMIN_ONLY_TYPES), mirroring settings.updated exactly — plugin registration is an admin-configuration action with no item/library/user content association for packages/db/src/query/events.ts's visibility predicate to gate on. NEVER carries the manifest itself, any config value, or any secret (LD4/LD9) — only the fields listed below.

name.description: The plugin's manifest-declared display name at registration time.

baseUrl.description: The plugin's HTTP(S) origin, as registered.

contentClass.description: The plugin's computed aggregate content-class scope (packages/db/migrations/0014_plugins.sql's plugins.content_class column comment).

grantedCapabilityTypes.description: The manifest-declared capability `type` values approved at registration (LD6 'capability set <= declared') — packages/plugin-protocol CAPABILITY_TYPES values today ('metadata-provider' | 'event-subscriber'), never the full capability objects.

eventTypes.description: The outbox event types granted to an event-subscriber capability at registration (LD6 'event grants <= requested'); empty when no event-subscriber capability was granted.

registeredAtMs.description: Epoch ms this row was committed (plugins.approved_at_ms at insert time).
